title: Human Activity Classification Under Domain and Temporal Shift
description: Versioned code, technical reports, and portable evidence for linked POLAR, V-COCO, and Okutama-Action studies. The release adds a sealed tracked-video evaluation in which an eight-frame temporal model reaches 0.7854 macro-F1, compared with 0.7458 for the matched static model, together with fixed-budget routing, paired scenario-cluster uncertainty, and a complete execution lineage. It also includes the CPTR architecture study, whose positive fixed-validation result did not persist under recording-grouped cross-fitting, and retains the earlier source-overlap and person-level transfer releases.
